blurb: Hawk Ridge Winery offers award-winning wines including dry, sweet, white, red, and rosé varieties. Guests can enjoy wine flights starting at $15, local craft beers on tap, frozen wine slushies, and cuisine by Uncommon Grill. The winery hosts live music on weekends and various events such as yoga and handbag bingo on its 58-acre property in Watertown, CT.
